evidence.note: Explicit pay-now commitment at turn 4 was unnecessarily reconfirmed at turn 5.
Commitment was reconfirmed, then closing thanked the caller for payment as though money had moved.
After accepting the full amount, agent reconfirmed and then thanked the caller for payment as if completed.
Punjabi switch succeeded, but the explicit app-payment commitment was reconfirmed.
One concise reason converted the caller; the commitment was then unnecessarily reconfirmed.
Official-app alternative resolved distrust; the explicit commitment was then reconfirmed.

clusters.recommendation: Treat an explicit pay-now commitment as terminal: acknowledge once and end without another question.

evidence.note: English trust response gave the safe route without a direct pay-now close; the next explanation was interrupted and commitment was never reached.

clusters.recommendation: Resolve authenticity in one turn: identify AI status, give independent official-app verification, then ask one pay-now question.

evidence.note: Confirmed customer disputed the purchase; agent called it a wrong number and falsely claimed it would update the record.

clusters.recommendation: Give dispute precedence when the named customer denies the purchase; wrong_number applies only when the person is not the named customer.

evidence.note: Safe verification was offered, but the caller only agreed to check and disconnected before an explicit payment commitment.

clusters.recommendation: After a conditional app-check response, use one concise verify-then-pay micro-close and stop if commitment remains absent.

evidence.note: Caller twice refused to engage with an AI; agent continued collection attempts instead of closing or providing a human route.

clusters.recommendation: If the caller refuses to continue with an AI twice, provide the official human-support route and end recovery pressure.

evidence.note: Agent said late charges may apply even though the frozen outstanding already included a Rs 250 late charge.

clusters.recommendation: Say the frozen outstanding already includes the stated late charge; never say it may apply later.

evidence.note: Agent converted a promise into the stronger statement that payment would be done.

clusters.recommendation: Record a promise as a promise; never state that payment will be done or has completed.

evidence.note: After the caller twice said the app was unavailable, the agent repeated the download/pay request rather than offering one secondary path.

clusters.recommendation: After one app-unavailable statement, stop repeating download instructions and offer one realistic date or callback path.

evidence.note: Agent recovered from interruption but offered payment/callback before re-establishing the minimal context the busy caller missed.

clusters.recommendation: After interruption, restate only lender, product, amount and one action before asking again.

evidence.note: Spoken containment was acceptable, but disposition was fraud_claim rather than the allowed escalation outcome.

clusters.recommendation: Fix the output extractor taxonomy separately; the agent prompt cannot repair an invalid enum value reliably.
